lansync.title: How LAN Network Synchronization Works
lansync.subtitle: Share patient data across workstations on your local network — no cloud, no latency, no GDPR risk.

step1.title: 1. Set Up a Shared Folder
step1.desc: Point PISUM to a shared network folder (NAS, SMB share, or mapped drive). All workstations on the same network will then access the same database.

step2.title: 2. One Shared Password
step2.desc: The database is AES-256 encrypted. Set one password on the first workstation — all other PCs will enter the same password to connect.

step3.title: 3. Instant Sync Across PCs
step3.desc: Each workstation reads and writes directly to the shared database. Changes appear instantly across all connected computers.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.intro: Everything you need to know before subscribing.
faq.q1: Can I change my plan at any time?
faq.a1: Yes — upgrade or cancel your subscription anytime from your dashboard. Changes take effect immediately.
faq.a2: No. All plans are month-to-month with no long-term commitment. Annual billing saves 20% compared to monthly. You can cancel anytime from your dashboard.
faq.q3: Is the Free plan truly free?
faq.a3: Yes — no credit card required, no time limit. The Free plan allows you to explore PISUM with 10 templates, 50 reports per month, and PDF export. Upgrade when you're ready.
faq.a4: AI Dictation converts your voice into structured radiological report text in real-time. It operates via a secure API — audio is never stored. Your monthly quota resets on the 1st of each month.
faq.a5: All payments are processed by Lemon Squeezy, a PCI-compliant payment platform. PISUM never stores your banking details.
faq.q6: Where is my data stored? Is PISUM GDPR compliant?
faq.a6: Your patient reports are stored locally on your machine — PISUM never uploads clinical data to the cloud. Account information (name, email, subscription status) is hosted on Supabase with EU servers. PISUM is fully GDPR compliant.
faq.q7: Does PISUM require an internet connection?
faq.a7: Yes. PISUM requires an active internet connection for AI Dictation, AI Enhancer, and subscription management. While your patient reports and templates are stored locally on your machine, AI features securely connect to our cloud API.
faq.q8: Is there a free trial for paid plans?
faq.a8: The Free plan is a permanent free tier — no time limit, no credit card required. Starter, Pro, and Expert all include a 14-day free trial, allowing you to experience the full feature set risk-free before being charged. All paid plans are covered by a 30-day money-back guarantee.
